verdict.rationale: macOS has no public system-wide API surface that mirrors UI capabilities—no OpenAPI/API docs found (probes 404), and evidence only covers UI features (Continuity, Handoff, Migration Assistant) and command-line utilities like pbcopy/fs_usage, none of which constitute a documented API parity with the UI. No evidence macOS exposes an API-native way to perform arbitrary UI actions programmatically.
